small_guidance: Fix BN folding: instead of replacing batch_norm with identity scale/shift, fold the running stats and affine into scale=gamma/sqrt(var+eps), shift=beta - mean*scale and apply them inside bn_meansub_kernel; also remove the redundant self.batch_norm(y) call which double-applies normalization. Keep the autotune grid but add a (32,32,16) num_warps=2 fallback to confirm SMEM fits.
large_guidance: Redesign so the conv-transpose kernel writes directly into a fused epilogue that performs BN (using folded scale/shift from running_mean/var and gamma/beta) plus the per-(N,C) spatial-mean subtraction. Compute the mean in a second pass kernel over the conv output (one program per (N,C)) and fuse the subtract with a final store, instead of running torch's batch_norm in between. Use channels_last-style indexing on the conv-transpose output so the BN+mean reduction is contiguous along spatial.
